doe: const roads = H.map.roads || []; const [sx, sy] = H.stad; let best = null; for (const r of roads) { const Z = r.z; if (!Z || !r.pts) continue; for (let i = 1; i < Z.length - 1; i++) { if (Z[i] > 5) { const d = Math.hypot(r.pts[i][0] - sx, r.pts[i][1] - sy); if (!best || d < best.d) best = { d, x: r.pts[i][0], y: r.pts[i][1], z: Z[i], r, i }; } } } if (!best) { H.noteer('geen viaduct in map.roads (' + roads.length + ' wegen)'); return; } H.meet('viaduct', [Math.round(best.x), Math.round(best.y), +best.z.toFixed(1), Math.round(best.d)]); const P = best.r.pts; const dx = P[best.i + 1][0] - P[best.i - 1][0], dy = P[best.i + 1][1] - P[best.i - 1][1]; const L = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1; const nx = -dy / L, ny = dx / L; await H.jump(best.x + nx * 16, best.y + ny * 16, 6000); const g = H.gh(best.x + nx * 16, best.y + ny * 16); H.cam(best.x + nx * 11, best.y + ny * 11, g + 1.6, best.x - nx * 4, best.y - ny * 4, g + best.z * 0.85, 75); await H.shot('onder-schuin', 4000); H.cam(best.x + nx * 1.5 + dx / L * 6, best.y + ny * 1.5 + dy / L * 6, g + 1.7, best.x + nx * 1.5 + dx / L * 30, best.y + ny * 1.5 + dy / L * 30, g + best.z * 0.7, 70); await H.shot('onder-langs', 3500); H.cam(best.x + nx * 40, best.y + ny * 40, g + 4, best.x, best.y, g + best.z * 0.6, 55); await H.shot('zij', 3500); H.camOff();

const PS = await H.imp('pigeonspots'); const s = PS.getPigeonSpotsForRender()[0]; if (!s) { H.noteer('geen duivenplek'); return; } await H.jump(s.x + 1.2, s.y + 0.8, 5000); await H.shot('te-voet-bij-duivenplek', 3000); H.meet('promptTekst', H.zichtbaar(/Fluit een duif|Niet nu/)); const VEH = await H.imp('vehicle'); const pt = H.map.nearestRoadPoint(s.x, s.y, 40, true, true); const v = pt && VEH.spawnVehicleOnRoad(H.map, pt.road, false, Math.random, false, false, pt, false, null); if (!v) { H.noteer('geen voertuig'); return; } v.road = null; v.perfTemp = true; v.x = s.x + 1.5; v.y = s.y + 1; v.speed = 0; H.w.vehicles.push(v); H.p.x = v.x; H.p.y = v.y; H.p.enterVehicle(v, H.w); await H.shot('in-auto-bij-duivenplek', 3000); H.p.exitVehicle(H.map, H.w); const i = H.w.vehicles.indexOf(v); if (i >= 0) H.w.vehicles.splice(i, 1);

await H.jump(...H.stad, 6000); const g = H.gh(H.p.x, H.p.y); H.cam(H.p.x - 25, H.p.y + 25, g + 30, H.p.x + 40, H.p.y - 40, g, 60); await H.shot('route-van-boven', 3000); H.camOff(); await H.shot('route-speler', 1500);

const BM = await H.imp('bigmoment'); await H.jump(...H.stad, 3000); BM.showBigMoment(BM.momentVanBanner({ kind: 'pass', title: 'Missie geslaagd', reason: 'Je bent op tijd bij Oma.', reward: 250, missie: 'Op de fiets naar Oma' })); await H.shot('geslaagd', 2500); await H.sleep(4000); BM.showBigMoment(BM.momentVanBanner({ kind: 'fail', title: 'Missie mislukt', reason: 'Je bent te laat.', reward: 0, missie: 'Op de fiets naar Oma' })); await H.shot('mislukt', 2500); await H.sleep(4000);

const SU = await H.imp('shopui'); const S = await H.imp('shops'); const list = (S.getShops && S.getShops()) || H.w.shops || []; const arr = Array.isArray(list) ? list : Object.values(list); const soorten = {}; for (const s of arr) { const k = s.kind || s.type || '?'; if (!soorten[k]) soorten[k] = s; } H.meet('soorten', Object.keys(soorten).join(',')); let n = 0; for (const [k, s] of Object.entries(soorten)) { if (!/gun|wapen|weapon|car|auto|garage|vehicle|snack|bike|fiets/i.test(k)) continue; try { SU.openShopMenu(H.w, s); await H.shot('winkel-' + k, 1800); SU.closeShopMenu({ save: false }); } catch (e) { H.noteer(k + ': ' + e.message); } await H.sleep(500); if (++n >= 4) break; }
